# Pull Requests Policy

Thank you for your interest!

This repository is published **as-is** under the GPL-3.0 license.

- We do **not** provide support.
- We do **not** accept issues.
- Pull requests are **not accepted from the public**.

Only collaborators who have been explicitly added to this repository may open pull requests.
If you are not a collaborator, please fork this project and continue development under the GPL.

To avoid confusion, we kindly ask redistributors of modified versions to use a **different project name and branding**.

## Why This Policy?

ecobee-mcp is a personal project tailored to a specific Ecobee setup. It depends on the Ecobee API, which may change without notice, and is not designed as a general-purpose tool. Supporting all hardware configurations and API changes is beyond the scope of this project.

---

> Non-collaborator pull requests will be automatically closed by a bot.
